source_bound_receipt_v1.failure: all projected_value_change cases passed because receipt bound source semantics but not the exact emitted view

experiments.interpretation: A source-bound projection receipt is insufficient. The actual reader-visible projection/wire form must also be cryptographically/structurally bound and semantically validated. Zero unsafe accepts is only for the constructed mutation family, not a production guarantee.

cove_task.result: compiled view Pareto-dominates raw on measured accuracy and prompt tokens

experiments.interpretation: The best representation is task/reader/cost dependent. Operation-specific compiled COVE dominates raw on one task, while typed intent trades modest accuracy gain for substantial token cost on another. Compactness is infeasible when output contract fails.

experiments.setup: 20 semantic fields; each operation requires uniformly 2..6 fields; compare arbitrary fixed five-field compact view with operation-compiled required-only view
experiments.interpretation: Visual or fixed compactness is a poor proxy for semantic sufficiency. Operation-specific loss budgets can be smaller while retaining the constructed required slice. The 100% compiled result is by construction and is not empirical FRANK performance evidence.
